mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings declines, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC remains negative over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 95.0) reduces corporate investment and growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal improving consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low-growth manufacturing regime (INDPRO < 95.0 and GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized) reflects weak economic fundamentals that suppress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 and GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or joint condition Rank IC < 0.03.
